## `methanol-nmr.out`

A **verbatim excerpt** of one real run. The retained lines are byte-identical
to what ORCA wrote; the sections between them (the long SCF printout, the
citation list) were removed so the fixture stays small. No number was edited.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Route | `! B3LYP def2-SVP NMR`, `%pal nprocs 2 end` |
| Block | `%EPRNMR` with `NUCLEI = ALL H/C/O { SHIFT, SSALL }` |
| Molecule | methanol, CH3OH, 6 atoms, charge 0, multiplicity 1 |
| Outcome | SCF converged in 8 cycles, −115.56211637243774 Eh; terminated normally in 15.8 s |
| Shieldings (ppm) | C 141.174, O 342.467; H 28.336, 28.175, 28.175, 32.237 |
| Couplings (Hz) | J(C,H) 179.858, J(O,H) −91.723, J(C,O) 15.511 |
| Full log | 8,514 lines / 471 KB; this excerpt keeps the banner, input echo, SCF result, shielding summary, coupling summary and termination line |

ORCA numbers nuclei from **0** in input order. The shielding reader shifts that
to the app's 1-based atom order; the coupling matrix keeps ORCA's 0-based order,
as its `indexing` field states.

## Other fixtures

`water-sp.out`, `water-opt-freq.out`, `failure-scf.out` and `not-orca.out` are
trimmed blocks in the documented ORCA format used by the parser, gate and
termination tests.
